lines.text: My iyin wa funwa ati imole
lines.marked: My ìyìn wá fúnwa àti ìmọ́lẹ̀̀

lines.text: O le okunkun lo, o nm'okan wa yo.
lines.marked: Ó lé òkùnkùn lọ, ó nm'ọkàn wa yọ̀.

lines.text: Ore-Ofe Olorun si wa iyanu ni
lines.marked: Ọrẹ-Ọ̀fẹ́ Ọlọ́run sì wá ìyanu ni

lines.text: Ope ore-ofe Re wa nibi gbogbo
lines.marked: Ọpẹ́ ọ̀rẹ́-ọ̀fẹ́ Rẹ wà níbi gbogbo

lines.text: Ore-ofe nla ti' nfo gbogbo eda mo
lines.marked: Ọrẹ-ọ̀fẹ́ ńlá ti' ńfọ gbogbo ẹ̀dá mọ́

lines.text: Wa to ebun ofe wo, ore-ofe nla.
lines.marked: Wá tó ẹ̀bùn ọ̀fẹ́ wò, ọrẹ-ọ̀fẹ́ ńlá.

lines.text: O ga ju orun lo, o jin ju okun.
lines.marked: Ó ga ju ọ̀run lọ, ó jìn ju òkun.

lines.text: A nf' ore-ore yi, lo gbogb'enia
lines.marked: A nf' ọ̀rẹ́-ọ̀rẹ́ yí, ló gbogb'enia

lines.text: We, iwo t'eru, y'o gbe won fun
lines.marked: Wẹ̀, ìwo t'ẹrú, y'ó gbé wọn fún

lines.text: Enika to wa, a ki y'o tanu
lines.marked: Enika tó wà, a kì y'ó tánú

lines.text: Yio fe o lofe, ma siyemeji.
lines.marked: Yío fẹ́ ò lọ́fẹ́, má ṣiyèméjì.
